title: Ambient tensor coordinates before the second conormal pullback
statement: Let i:Z→X and i':Z'→X' be closed immersions [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf] in a cartesian square [def-pc-fibre-product] with maps g:X→X' and f:Z→Z' and equality h:i≫g=f≫i'. Fix affine opens U⊆X and U'⊆X' with U⊆g⁻¹U'. Put A=Γ(X',U'), B=Γ(X,U), J=i'.ker.ideal U', V'=i'⁻¹U', V=i⁻¹U, C=Γ(Z',V'), D=Γ(Z,V), and N=Γ((tensorPullback i').obj i'.ker.toModules,V') [def-pc-module-pullback]. The algebra structures are induced by g.appLE and f.appLE; the inclusion V⊆f⁻¹V' follows from h. There exists an additive equivalence e:B⊗_A J.Cotangent ≃ N⊗_C D. For b∈B, a∈J and an ideal section s' over U' with i'.ker.toModulesι(s')=a, it sends b⊗class(a) to η_i'(s')⊗i.app(U)(b), where η_i' is the chosen normalized tensor-pullback adjunction unit. This equivalence concerns only tensor modules, not sections of the second pullback f* N.

source.place: Tags 0473 (affine tensor source), 01R3 (2) (conormal sections), 01JU (1) (base-change ideal). Read the cited Stacks web pages on 2026-10-13.

proof.text: Put A=Gamma(X',U'), B=Gamma(X,U), J=i'.ker.ideal U', C=Gamma(Z',V'), D=Gamma(Z,V), and N=Gamma(i'*i'.ker,V'). The section maps A to C and B to D are surjective by Scheme.Hom.app_surjective. IsPullback.of_isLimit hc and isoPullback_hom_fst, ker_comp_of_isIso and ker_fst_of_isClosedImmersion identify i.ker with i'.ker.comap g. ideal_comap_appLE then gives ker(B to D)=J.map(A to B). appLE_comp_appLE and h identify the two composites A to D, providing the compatible scalar towers.

Apply affine_conormal_sections to i', U', R=A, r=id and J=ker(i'.app U'). Its semilinear equivalence at the identity is the A-linear equivalence e:J.Cotangent to N with the normalized unit formula. Transport Ideal.Cotangent.smul_eq_zero_of_mem through e to show J annihilates N.

The proved private helper tensorQuotientBijective shows B tensor_A N to D tensor_A N is bijective. First Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap and tensor induction show JB annihilates B tensor_A N: algebraMap(a) acts on b tensor n as b tensor (a smul n), which vanishes. Hence the tensor of the kernel inclusion of B to D is zero. Mathlib rTensor_exact identifies the kernel of the tensor map with the range of this zero map; rTensor_surjective proves surjectivity. Separately CompatibleSMul.of_algebraMap_surjective for A to C and equivOfCompatibleSMul identify N tensor_C D with N tensor_A D. Compose TensorProduct.congr(id,e), the bijective tensor map, tensor swap, and the inverse scalar-change equivalence. This replaces the explicit quotient-tensor route with Mathlib tensor right exactness, without flatness or new unproved statements.

The composite sends b tensor class(a) definitionally to e(class(a)) tensor_C i.app(b). Rewrite e(class(a)) using the normalized equation supplied by affine_conormal_sections, giving the required adjunction unit on s'. The constructions use neither nonzero-ring nor proper-ideal hypotheses, and cover J=0, J=A and zero rings.

theorem closedImmersion_conormal_affine_tensor_coordinates
    {X Z X' Z' : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ X) (i' : Z' ⟶ X')
    [IsClosedImmersion i] [IsClosedImmersion i']
    (g : X ⟶ X') (f : Z ⟶ Z') (h : i ≫ g = f ≫ i')
    (hc : IsLimit (PullbackCone.mk i f h))
    (U : X.affineOpens) (U' : X'.affineOpens) (H : U.1 ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ U'.1) :
    letI : Algebra Γ(X', U'.1) Γ(X, U.1) := (g.appLE U'.1 U.1 H).hom.toAlgebra
    let V' : Z'.affineOpens := ⟨i' ⁻¹ᵁ U'.1, U'.2.preimage i'⟩
    let V : Z.affineOpens := ⟨i ⁻¹ᵁ U.1, U.2.preimage i⟩
    let K : V.1 ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ V'.1 := by
      change i ⁻¹ᵁ U.1 ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ i' ⁻¹ᵁ U'.1
      rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_preimage, ← h, Scheme.Hom.comp_preimage]
      exact i.preimage_mono H
    letI : Algebra Γ(Z', V'.1) Γ(Z, V.1) := (f.appLE V'.1 V.1 K).hom.toAlgebra
    ∃ e : (Γ(X, U.1) ⊗[Γ(X', U'.1)] (i'.ker.ideal U').Cotangent) ≃+
        (Γ((tensorPullback i').obj i'.ker.toModules, V'.1) ⊗[Γ(Z', V'.1)] Γ(Z, V.1)),
      ∀ (b : Γ(X, U.1)) (a : i'.ker.ideal U') (s' : Γ(i'.ker.toModules, U'.1)),
        i'.ker.toModulesι.app U'.1 s' = (a : Γ(X', U'.1)) →
        e (b ⊗ₜ[Γ(X', U'.1)] (i'.ker.ideal U').toCotangent a) =
          (show Γ((tensorPullback i').obj i'.ker.toModules, V'.1) from
            ((Classical.choose (exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction i')).unit.app
              i'.ker.toModules).app U'.1 s') ⊗ₜ[Γ(Z', V'.1)] i.app U.1 b
